body.p: (task 0.3). tools/lint.sh runs the ast-grep rule self-tests and the lint CMake target (lint-clang-tidy + lint-ast-grep) in the debug build tree. clang-tidy covers src/, tests/ and the header check units; .clang-tidy header filter now also covers tests/. ast-grep (@ast-grep/cli 0.45.3, pinned in tools/package.json) rules in tools/ast-grep/rules/, with examples in tools/ast-grep/tests/: banned abbreviations and single-letter names (as a whole name or one snake_case word), allocation outside src/allocator.c, abort/exit/printing in src/, more than three parameters (variadic counts), bare bool parameters. The guideline rule "pointer parameters without a length" is not yet a lint: it needs the view types from task 0.5 first.
